Linux is worth learning because it runs servers, embedded systems, Raspberry Pi computers, development tools, and many repair and recovery workflows. Begin with the class materials, then follow the sequence in order. At home, Terminal Quest and Bashcrawl work through Windows WSL, Windows Git Bash, Mac, Chromebook Linux, Linux, Android, or iPhone/iPad. In class, they work without Internet after Linux Mint is installed or while Linux Mint is running from the bootable USB. A phone is slower and more difficult than a computer, but it is possible while waiting for classroom hardware.
